description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the brand-guidelines SKILL.md to discover the exact proprietary hex values (Dark=#141413, Light=#faf9f5, Orange=#d97757, Blue=#6a9bcc, Green=#788c5d) and typography rules. (2) Open both raw PPTX files using python-pptx and apply brand colors to slide backgrounds (using Dark for dark slides, Light for light slides). (3) Apply Poppins (or Arial fallback) to all text runs with font size ≥24pt (headings), and Lora (or Georgia fallback) to all text runs with font size <24pt (body text). (4) Set all text colors to appropriate brand colors (Light on dark backgrounds, Dark on light backgrounds). (5) Apply accent colors to non-text shapes, cycling in the exact order: Orange → Blue → Green → Orange → ... across all shapes in slide order. (6) Save the transformed presentations as new files distinct from the raw drafts. The key traps are: the exact hex values (especially #d97757 for orange, not standard web orange), the 24pt threshold for heading vs body font selection, and the strict Orange→Blue→Green cycling order for accent shapes.
